VCR Inc. (2002). Challenge Registry Guide to Entity & Facility-Based Reporting, Version 2.2, November 2002. Canada's Climate Change Voluntary Challenge & Registry, Ottawa. 54 pp. http://www.vcr-mvr.ca/vcr-020.cfm

REPORTING GUIDE, NO TECHNOLOGY DATA. Programme guidance for voluntary GHG reporting (reporting boundaries, base year, verification FAQs, quantification methods). Its Section 9 emission-factor tables (pp.35-43: boiler fuels, provincial electricity 1990-2001, transport fuels, biomass, coal mining, agriculture, coal-fired boilers) and unit-conversion tables are held as the separate extract vcr_2002_registration-guide-emission-factors_section9.pdf, which is the document written up as a factors file (STEM_factors.csv in other-reports). Nothing in the guide body is a technology parameter. Superseded for factors by eccc_2026_001.
